title: Apple cups
instructions: may be filled with a salad of mushrooms (cooked), stuffed olives (sliced), nuts and a few delicate tips of celery. Moisten the mixture with French dressing and top off with mayonnaise and whipped cream. This salad may be served with lettuce instead of in apples.  Shredded red pepper,  stoned olives and cabbage make a delicious combination.
